overview: Dominica is a small island country in the eastern Caribbean. Its capital is Roseau. It became independent from the United Kingdom in 1978. Dominica is home to the Kalinago, the only Indigenous people in the eastern Caribbean who still live on their own territory. It is a different country from the Dominican Republic.

geography.text: Dominica is mountainous and covered in rainforest, which has earned it the nickname 'the Nature Isle of the Caribbean'. It is a volcanic island, with hot springs and the Boiling Lake, a flooded vent that bubbles with volcanic heat. Heavy rainfall feeds its many rivers and waterfalls.
